description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:139-165 — Severity (line 119), LintResult (line 197), Finding (line 366) all have #[cfg_attr(feature='serde', derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize))], but Scope (line 139) and SubjectKind (line 155) do not. Since Finding contains neither Scope nor SubjectKind, JSON serialization of Finding is not blocked. But if a consumer wants to serialize LintRunner metadata or a run summary that includes Scope or SubjectKind, they cannot. Add #[cfg_attr(feature='serde', ...)] to Scope and SubjectKind for consistency.
title: Scope and SubjectKind missing serde derives while sibling types have them
